description: Queue a lot-transition walk: approach a `Transition Object` on the current lot, then the lot-switch handshake fires. Works as the in-world "walk out the front door to another property" path. Prerequisite: a Transition Object must be on the current lot and be your clicked target.
call_signatures: cf $CF walk-to-lot   # SCAFFOLD op — not yet implemented; handler may return ok:false or a stub. Prefer a concrete sibling op if your goal is actionable.
common_mistakes: This is a SCAFFOLD op — the convention is declared but the handler may be unimplemented or stubbed. Check the declaration's status field.
Relying on scaffold ops mid-run will either return a deferred marker or fail — prefer a concrete sibling op, and file an rd item if the missing behaviour blocks progress.
perception_hints: Your current position: perception.avatar.position.x, .y (tile coords); multiply by 16 for raw world coords
